name: legit_latex_Z7
label: legit
text:
We evaluate $g(x) = 2x^5 + 5x^4 + 1x^3 + 4x^2 + 1x + 3$ over $\mathbb{Z}_{7}$ for every residue.

1.  **For $x = 0$:**
    $$g(0) = 2\cdot 0^5 + 5\cdot 0^4 + 1\cdot 0^3 + 4\cdot 0^2 + 1\cdot 0^1 + 3\cdot 0^0 = 3 \equiv 3 \pmod {7}$$

2.  **For $x = 1$:**
    $$g(1) = 2\cdot 1^5 + 5\cdot 1^4 + 1\cdot 1^3 + 4\cdot 1^2 + 1\cdot 1^1 + 3\cdot 1^0 = 16 \equiv 2 \pmod {7}$$

3.  **For $x = 2$:**
    $$g(2) = 2\cdot 2^5 + 5\cdot 2^4 + 1\cdot 2^3 + 4\cdot 2^2 + 1\cdot 2^1 + 3\cdot 2^0 = 173 \equiv 5 \pmod {7}$$

4.  **For $x = 3$:**
    $$g(3) = 2\cdot 3^5 + 5\cdot 3^4 + 1\cdot 3^3 + 4\cdot 3^2 + 1\cdot 3^1 + 3\cdot 3^0 = 960 \equiv 1 \pmod {7}$$

5.  **For $x = 4$:**
    $$g(4) = 2\cdot 4^5 + 5\cdot 4^4 + 1\cdot 4^3 + 4\cdot 4^2 + 1\cdot 4^1 + 3\cdot 4^0 = 3463 \equiv 5 \pmod {7}$$

6.  **For $x = 5$:**
    $$g(5) = 2\cdot 5^5 + 5\cdot 5^4 + 1\cdot 5^3 + 4\cdot 5^2 + 1\cdot 5^1 + 3\cdot 5^0 = 9608 \equiv 4 \pmod {7}$$

7.  **For $x = 6$:**
    $$g(6) = 2\cdot 6^5 + 5\cdot 6^4 + 1\cdot 6^3 + 4\cdot 6^2 + 1\cdot 6^1 + 3\cdot 6^0 = 22401 \equiv 1 \pmod {7}$$

So the roots are exactly those $x$ with value $0$ modulo $7$.

text:
Compute the determinant by cofactor expansion along the first row.

$$\det\begin{pmatrix} 8 & 9 \\ 8 & 8 \end{pmatrix} = 8\cdot 8 - 9\cdot 8 = 64 - 72 = -8$$

$$\det\begin{pmatrix} 9 & 4 \\ 3 & 9 \end{pmatrix} = 9\cdot 9 - 4\cdot 3 = 81 - 12 = 69$$

$$\det\begin{pmatrix} 8 & 3 \\ 2 & 8 \end{pmatrix} = 8\cdot 8 - 3\cdot 2 = 64 - 6 = 58$$

$$\det\begin{pmatrix} 5 & 3 \\ 2 & 9 \end{pmatrix} = 5\cdot 9 - 3\cdot 2 = 45 - 6 = 39$$

$$\det\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 7 \\ 8 & 3 \end{pmatrix} = 1\cdot 3 - 7\cdot 8 = 3 - 56 = -53$$

$$\det\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 9 \\ 2 & 1 \end{pmatrix} = 1\cdot 1 - 9\cdot 2 = 1 - 18 = -17$$

$$\det\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 4 \\ 4 & 1 \end{pmatrix} = 1\cdot 1 - 4\cdot 4 = 1 - 16 = -15$$

$$\det\begin{pmatrix} 8 & 6 \\ 8 & 4 \end{pmatrix} = 8\cdot 4 - 6\cdot 8 = 32 - 48 = -16$$

$$\det\begin{pmatrix} 9 & 4 \\ 5 & 8 \end{pmatrix} = 9\cdot 8 - 4\cdot 5 = 72 - 20 = 52$$

$$\det\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 8 & 5 \end{pmatrix} = 1\cdot 5 - 2\cdot 8 = 5 - 16 = -11$$

$$\det\begin{pmatrix} 7 & 9 \\ 2 & 5 \end{pmatrix} = 7\cdot 5 - 9\cdot 2 = 35 - 18 = 17$$

$$\det\begin{pmatrix} 6 & 4 \\ 9 & 5 \end{pmatrix} = 6\cdot 5 - 4\cdot 9 = 30 - 36 = -6$$

text: The scheduler assigns each job to a worker lease and renews that lease on a heartbeat. When a heartbeat is missed twice, the lease expires and the job returns to the queue, so a slow worker can race a fast one on the same job. The fix is an idempotency key per job attempt, recorded in the same transaction as the completion row, together with a fencing token that the storage layer checks on every write.
